# ModDotPlot Browser v0.8.6

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.8.6 streamlines the choices introduced in v0.8.5. Multi-record sessions now open
in **Self plot**, terminal exact plots begin in **Bases**, and full k-mer footprints
are the sole exact geometry exposed by the browser. **Identity** remains available as
the alternate exact coloring, and the main **Similarity / Direction** control still
provides orientation coloring.

The user-facing product name is now **ModDotPlot Browser**. Technical package,
repository, export-header, and archive identifiers remain `moddotplot-interactive` so
existing build and integration workflows do not require a package-name migration.

See the [validation record](v0.8.6/VALIDATION.md) for checks performed on this source
copy.

## Interface defaults

When multiple FASTA records or files are loaded, the workspace opens in Self plot with
one sequence selector. Pairwise and Grid remain adjacent choices.

At one-base-per-cell detail, Bases is selected initially and the A/C/G/T legend is
titled **Base**. Identity coloring remains selectable. Exact matches always occupy
their complete aligned k-mer footprints; the K-mer anchors choice and exact-panel
direction shortcut are no longer shown.

## Naming and landing page

Application-facing headings and documentation use **ModDotPlot Browser**. The landing
page no longer includes the informal implementation claim, the abbreviated local-file
privacy line, or the human-genome sizing claim. The detailed privacy and validation
documents remain the authoritative descriptions of local processing and supported
scale.

## Compatibility

The scientific sketch estimator, fixed full-footprint exact computation, loaded-data
model, grid layout, feature tracks, and data/image export formats are unchanged. Core
anchor geometry may remain covered internally as a regression fixture, but it is not
an exposed browser display option in v0.8.6.
